## 1. Professional Identity & Engineering Philosophy

- **Name**: Belal Waheed
- **Current Location**: Cairo, Egypt
- **Title**: Full-Stack & Front-End Software Engineer
- **Specialization**: Offline-first progressive web applications (PWAs), distributed edge computing (Cloudflare Workers, D1 SQLite), modern frontend architecture (React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4), and resilient multi-platform systems.
- **Formal Education**: Bachelor of Information Technology, Sinai University (Class of 2026, GPA: 3.3 / 4.0). Coursework: Advanced Database Systems, Distributed Systems, Software Engineering Patterns, Algorithm Analysis, Information Security.

### Architectural Principles & Invariants
1. **Local-First Reliability**: Network connectivity is treated as an intermittent enhancement rather than an absolute dependency. Applications must maintain 0ms local read/write responsiveness with transactional client-side storage (Dexie.js / IndexedDB) and background synchronization.
2. **Layered Clean Architecture**: Strict separation of concerns adhering to Router/Controller -> Service -> Repository boundaries. Business domain rules are completely isolated from storage drivers and presentation logic.
3. **Strict Type Safety & Boundary Validation**: End-to-end type safety spanning edge runtimes down to client stores. All untrusted external inputs (API payloads, local storage state, route parameters) are validated fail-fast using Zod or Pydantic.
4. **Zero-AI Cliché & High-Craft UX**: Elimination of generic template aesthetics in favor of bespoke, WCAG AA compliant design systems (4.5:1 contrast, 8px spatial grid, CSS logical properties, fluid 60fps micro-animations).

## 2. Flagship Systems Architecture Deep-Dive: Markbel

- **Live Application**: https://mark.obel.workers.dev
- **Source Code Repository**: https://github.com/belal-waheed/markbel
- **Role**: Creator & Lead Systems Architect
- **License**: MIT (100% Free & Open-Source)
- **Automated Test Coverage**: 228 passing unit and integration tests across outbox sync, image fallback FSM, parser resilience, and metadata scraping.

### Problem Statement
Modern bookmark managers (Pocket, Raindrop.io, Omnivore) suffer from significant architectural limitations:
- Severe latency (200ms–1500ms) on basic create/update actions due to required synchronous roundtrips to remote cloud databases.
- Total loss of search and reading capabilities during network drops or in transit.
- Social media CDN expiration (Instagram, Reddit, X/Twitter image URLs expiring within 24 hours), causing broken thumbnail grids across user bookmark collections.
- Vendor lock-in and high recurring subscription fees.

### Architecture & System Design
Markbel resolves these issues through a dual-model, local-first architecture:

```
[Browser / Native Android / MV3 Extension]
       │
       ▼ (0ms latency)
[Client Dexie.js v5 IndexedDB] ──(Transactional Outbox)──┐
       ▲                                                 │
       │ (Reactive LiveQuery UI Update)                  │
[React 19 Presentation Layer]                            ▼ (Periodic / Online Delta Sync)
                                              [Cloudflare Workers Edge Router (Hono)]
                                                         │
                                        ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐
                                        ▼                                 ▼
                         [Cloudflare D1 SQLite Engine]      [Edge Media Scraper & Proxy]
                           (Monotonic Sequence Log)            (4-Stage Fallback FSM)
```

#### 1. Local Storage Engine & 0ms Outbox Pattern
- **Persistence Driver**: Dexie.js v5 wrapping browser IndexedDB with strict schema versioning and transactional atomicity.
- **Outbox Table**: Any mutation (add bookmark, edit tags, archive, delete) atomically updates the local cache and writes a mutation entry to `outbox_mutations` in a single local transaction.
- **Reactive UI**: Components subscribe via Dexie `useLiveQuery`, resulting in immediate 0ms UI updates without spinners or network blocks.

#### 2. Bi-Directional Delta Synchronization Engine
- **Conflict Arbitration**: Last-Write-Wins (LWW) resolution based on UTC ISO-8601 timestamps and monotonic client sequence counters.
- **Sequence Tracking**: Incremental sync tokens (`since` timestamp / cursor) prevent redundant payload transfers. The edge worker returns HTTP 304 Not Modified when no remote mutations exist.
- **Compaction**: Succeeded outbox records are purged while soft deletes (`deleted_at IS NOT NULL`) are replicated to remove entities across all paired devices.

#### 3. Deterministic 4-Stage Image Fallback Finite State Machine (FSM)
To prevent broken images from social media CDNs (Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, X/Twitter), Markbel employs an automated 4-tier fallback:
- **Tier 1 (Proxy WebP)**: Scraped OpenGraph images routed through Markbel's Cloudflare Worker image proxy with edge resizing and WebP transcoding.
- **Tier 2 (Direct Upstream Origin)**: Direct fallback to origin URL if the edge proxy encounters rate limits or upstream 403s.
- **Tier 3 (Microlink Edge Metadata)**: Fallback to Microlink API metadata scraping for dynamically rendered SPAs.
- **Tier 4 (Vector Deterministic Fallback)**: Client-side generated SVG icon styled based on bookmark category and domain hash, guaranteeing zero broken image placeholders.

#### 4. Cross-Platform Native Bridge & Extensions
- **Android App**: Built with Capacitor 8 and Java/Kotlin native plugins. Employs an Android OS Share Sheet Intent receiver that allows 1-tap bookmark saving from Twitter, Reddit, Chrome, or YouTube via a sub-50ms HUD overlay without opening the full web application.
- **Browser Extensions**: Manifest V3 extensions for Chromium (Chrome, Edge, Brave) and Mozilla Firefox featuring 1-click active tab capture, keyboard shortcuts (`Ctrl+Shift+S`), and instant badge feedback.

## 4. Comprehensive Technical Competencies

### Frontend Engineering
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: React 19, Next.js (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions), Vite.
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit, Dexie.js `useLiveQuery`, React Context, Zustand.
- **Languages**: TypeScript (Strict Mode, Generics, Utility Types, Discriminated Unions), JavaScript (ES2024+).
- **Styling & Design Systems**: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS-first `@theme` directives, OKLCH color palettes, CSS Grid / Flexbox, CSS Logical Properties, GSAP, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons.
- **Web Standards & Performance**: Progressive Web Apps (PWAs), Service Workers (Workbox), Web Workers, Cache API, Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP < 1.2s, INP < 50ms, CLS = 0).

### Backend, Cloud & Edge Infrastructure
- **Serverless & Edge Runtimes**: Cloudflare Workers (Hono, V8 Isolates), Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare D1 (Serverless Distributed SQLite), Cloudflare KV, Vercel Serverless.
- **Traditional Runtimes**: Node.js (v18, v20, v22), Express.js, C# / ASP.NET Core (MVC, Web API).
- **API Design**: RESTful APIs, OpenAPI / Swagger specifications, JSON-LD structured schemas, SSE (Server-Sent Events), WebSockets.
- **Authentication & Security**: JWT (JSON Web Tokens), OAuth2, Bcrypt password hashing, Helmet security headers, CORS preflight policies, CSRF mitigation, Zod boundary validation.

### Databases & Persistence
- **Relational**: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite), PostgreSQL (Supabase / Neon), Microsoft SQL Server.
- **Document / NoSQL**: MongoDB (Mongoose ODM, compound indexing, aggregation pipelines).
- **Client-Side**: Dexie.js v5, IndexedDB, LocalStorage, WebCrypto.

### Native & Extensions
- **Mobile Runtime**: Capacitor 8 (Android Studio, Gradle build pipelines, Intent bridges).
- **Browser Extensions**: Manifest V3 (Background Service Workers, declarativeNetRequest, activeTab, chrome.storage).

### DevOps, Tooling & Testing

- **Design & Prototyping**: Figma, Whimsical, Excalidraw.
